nodes.description: Auction token id (64) used in ERC1155 transfers.
ERC1155 token contract address used for safeTransferFrom calls.
Flag marking the auction as finalized in end() or pull().
Current highest bid amount; refunded to the previous winner.
Address of the current winning bidder, receives refund and NFT.
Configured auction duration (24 hours).
Auction start timestamp set in constructor.
Auction end timestamp, extendable by bids near the deadline.
Recipient of the 15% protocol fee.
Seller address receiving proceeds or the NFT if no bids.
Constructor initializing token, id, times, seller and haus addresses.
Payable bid function: checks tx.origin, timing and bid size, refunds previous winner, extends endTime and records new winner.
Finalizes a live-ended auction: transfers ERC1155 to winner and distributes ETH to haus and seller.
Returns the ERC1155 to the seller when no bids were placed.
View helper returning whether block.timestamp is before endTime.
ERC1155 receiver hook; returns the acceptance selector and can be re-entered during transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as bidder, winner and stored in winning.
Block timestamp driving start/end checks and endTime extension.
Origin address compared with msg.sender to block contract bidders.
winning.transfer(lastBid) refund executed before state updates in bid().
haus.transfer(hausFee) protocol fee payout in end().
seller.transfer(address(this).balance) proceeds payout in end().
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom to the winner inside end(), triggering receiver callback.
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom to the seller inside pull(), triggering receiver callback.
balance = address(this).balance cached in end().
hausFee = balance.div(20).mul(3) computed in end().

edges.reason: Constructor writes the ERC1155 token address.
Constructor sets the auction token id.
Constructor sets startTime.
Constructor derives endTime from startTime + length.
Constructor sets auction length.
Constructor sets the minimum opening bid lastBid.
Constructor sets the seller payout address.
Constructor sets the haus fee address.
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender to gate bidders, an origin-based access restriction.
block.timestamp decides whether the auction started or ended inside bid().
msg.sender is the bidder identity used in bid().
bid() assigns msg.sender to the winning state variable.
lastBid is the amount refunded to the previous winner.
winning is the recipient of the refund transfer in bid().
External value transfer to the previous winner happens before lastBid/winning are updated, enabling reentrant bid().
Bids near the deadline rewrite endTime based on block.timestamp.
live() reads endTime to report auction status.
live() compares block.timestamp with endTime.
end() requires the auction to be not live via live().
pull() requires the auction to be not live via live().
end() invokes the ERC1155 safeTransferFrom to the winner.
pull() invokes the ERC1155 safeTransferFrom to the seller.
end() pays the protocol fee to haus.
end() pays remaining balance to the seller.
safeTransferFrom calls onERC1155Received on the receiving winner contract, re-entering before ended is set.
safeTransferFrom in pull() can invoke the receiver hook on a contract seller before ended is set.
token address is used as the ERC1155 target in end().
winning is the NFT recipient in end().
id is the ERC1155 token id transferred in end().
token address is used as the ERC1155 target in pull().
seller is the NFT recipient in pull().
end() caches the contract balance in the balance local variable.
hausFee is computed from the cached balance.
hausFee derived from the balance through division and multiplication feeds the haus transfer.
haus is the recipient of the fee transfer in end().
seller is the recipient of the remaining balance transfer.
ended flag guards end() against repeated finalization.
ended flag guards pull() against repeated finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: balance is a temporary local cache of address(this).balance used only inside end(); it should be normalized into the end() function node.
hausFee only exists to compute the amount sent by haus.transfer, so it should be merged into that unsafe operation.
